title: test(types): state spec 18's optional select-option `kind` as a deliberate widening in the tier-1 convergence pins
body:
Fixes #12711
Clause-②: no

## What

`@objectstack/spec` 18 adds an optional `kind` ('open' | 'won' | 'lost') to `SelectOptionSchema` (objectstack#23846). Both objectui select-option faces derive the spec's keys by reference, so both now carry it. That turned four tier-1 convergence pins in `select-option-tier1-convergence-7014.test.ts` false (TS2344) against objectstack `main`'s spec, which is the next red row of the hourly Spec Shape Gate.

The pins now state `kind` as a deliberate optional widening:

- `SpecKindKey` is the Extract of `'kind'` from the keys of the spec's own `SelectOption` type. It is `'kind'` where the spec declares it and `never` where it does not, read off the spec's type rather than a version check. So the pins hold against both the installed `18.0.0-next.2` (no `kind`; this repo's Type Check uses it) and objectstack `main`'s spec (the Spec Shape Gate uses it).
- The form face gained exactly `'description' | SpecKindKey`, and the object-metadata face exactly `'default' | SpecKindKey`. The kept-every-member pins drop the same keys before comparing against the historical records. The two set-difference pins are renamed `…GainedOnlyDescriptionAndKind` and `…GainedOnlyDefaultAndKind`.
- New pins: `kind` is optional on both faces, and it is the spec's own member by reference.
- Runtime half: "lists exactly the keys the spec declares" allows `kind` only when the spec shape has it. A new test asserts that `kind` is either an optional spec key (absent stays absent, and an undeclared category is refused) or refused by name (unrecognized_keys). Any other new spec key still breaks the comparison.
- `rejectsUndeclaredKeyOnFormFace` / `acceptsEveryDeclaredKeyOnFormFace` were re-read. `weight` is still refused with `kind` on the face. The accepting literals don't write `kind`, because on the installed spec it would be an excess property; the docblock says so, and the optional pins cover acceptance.

Not done, per the card: no `as any`, the `PRE_CONVERGENCE_*` records are byte-unchanged, and `kind` is not Omitted from either face. The test docblock explains why the form face keeps `kind` even though the spec's form-view options leave it out (the open question in the report).

Changeset: one empty-frontmatter changeset. `check-changeset-presence` has no carve-out for `src/__tests__/` and was red without one.

## Evidence

The main line is objectstack main `2054a0888c`, with `packages/spec` built, packed and injected by `spec-shape-gate.mjs inject` (the gate's own recipe). The installed line is `18.0.0-next.2`.

| reading | installed | main |
|---|---|---|
| this head, `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` | 0 | 0 |
| this head, vitest on the file | 9/9 | 9/9 |
| old test (96fa4b9) | 0 | 2: TS2344 at 130, 138, 150, 157 |
| probe: SpecKindKey equals 'kind' | 2 (never) | 0 |
| ablation: a face gains `weight` | 2: all four pins | 2: all four pins |
| ablation: faces lose `description` | 2 | 2 |
| ablation: `kind` made required on the form face | 2 | 2: optional pin |

Every ablation was restored by `git checkout HEAD --`. Each time, the restored blob equalled HEAD blob 3b00710 and `git diff HEAD` was empty. The install was restored and `pnpm-lock.yaml` is unchanged (sha256 check OK).

Local gates on the installed line (the test bytes are identical to head e6b6093):
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` 0;
- vitest `packages/types/src/__tests__` 0 (384 files, 10357 tests);
- `check:changeset-claims` 0, `changeset:check` 0, `check:test-path-roots` 0, `check:spec-symbols` 0;
- eslint on the file 0;
- `check-changeset-presence` 0 at e6b6093.

NOT MEASURED: on the main line, which branch the new runtime `kind` test took. The type-side probe proves the main spec type declares `kind`.

## Acceptance notes

- Form face and `kind`: the spec's FormSelectOptionSchema leaves out both `kind` and `default`. objectui's form face has carried `default` since before the convergence, and its zod twin spreads the same spec shape. Whether to narrow the face is a separate face change, reported as an open question and not built here.
- Out of scope: the record path, kanban and the Studio column reading `kind` (Targets 2–4 of objectstack#23809).
